title: Drain old-secret NSX Policy requests before credential cutover
prompt:
Platform engineering rotates the Basic credential used by an NSX Policy client while inventory requests may still be in flight. Finish the `VcfNsxCredentialGate` PowerShell module so a cutover queues new requests, drains every request using the old configured client, and only then publishes the new client. An in-flight request must never be stranded by switching the server-side secret before it completes.

Before implementing, research the `ListGroupForDomain` operation and its VMware VCF PowerCLI 9.1 generated binding in official VMware sources. Confirm its method signature, parameter order, optional query behavior, and response model, and cite the source URLs consulted.

The supplied manifest must continue to require `VMware.Sdk.Vcf.SddcManager` version `13.5.0.25380678`; its official `VMware.OpenAPI` dependency loads the generated `VMware.Bindings.Nsx.Policy` client and model types used here. Do not install, copy, generate, or vendor any VMware module, assembly, binding, SDK, or OpenAPI specification. Production API traffic must use caller-supplied, already configured `VMware.Bindings.Nsx.Policy.Api.PolicyApi` instances. Do not bypass them with `Invoke-RestMethod`, `Invoke-WebRequest`, `HttpClient`, curl, raw sockets, or another direct REST client.

Export exactly these three functions and preserve the supplied signatures except for the approved cutover-action parameter on `Set-VcfNsxCredential`:

- `New-VcfNsxCredentialGate -PolicyApi <VMware.Bindings.Nsx.Policy.Api.PolicyApi>` creates and returns an independent gate whose current client is `PolicyApi`. It performs no API request.
- `Get-VcfNsxGroupPage -Gate <object> -DomainId <string>` acquires a shared request lease, snapshots the current client, invokes generated `ListGroupForDomain` exactly once, and keeps that lease until the call and response validation finish. Call the generated method in documented order. Pass all seven optional query arguments as genuinely unset values. Reject a null response or a response whose `Results` collection is null; otherwise return the generated `GroupListResult` object unchanged.
- `Set-VcfNsxCredential -Gate <object> -Cutover <scriptblock>` performs the credential cutover. Exactly one cutover may own the gate at a time. Once waiting for ownership, later group requests must queue behind it. Wait for every earlier request lease to finish, invoke `Cutover` exactly once while holding exclusive ownership, require that action to perform the caller-owned server credential rotation and return one configured `VMware.Bindings.Nsx.Policy.Api.PolicyApi`, atomically publish that returned client before releasing the lock, and then release queued requests. The function itself performs no API request and returns no object. If the action throws or returns the wrong type, keep the old client published and release the lock in `finally`.

All lock acquisition must be paired with release in `finally`, including when the generated binding throws or response validation fails. Gates must not share synchronization or client state. Do not dispose either configured client; their lifecycle is caller-owned.

For `ListGroupForDomain`, the only request parameter that is set is `domain-id`. Unset `cursor`, `include_mark_for_delete_objects`, `included_fields`, `member_types`, `page_size`, `sort_ascending`, and `sort_by` must be omitted from the URI rather than sent as empty strings, false, zero, or default values.

Run `pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -File tests/verify.ps1`. Do not modify the module manifest; edit only `VcfNsxCredentialGate/VcfNsxCredentialGate.psm1`.
scenario: a credential cutover queues new work and drains every NSX Policy request using the old secret before the new configured client is published
